decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) a large, abrupt U-axis spike near index 580 with correlated N/E responses and no immediate reversal; (2) a coordinated linear trend beginning at index 725 across all axes, suggestive of a potential step or platform onset. Other intervals show typical noise or smooth motion without ambiguous superposed changes.

regions.observation: Sharp, multi-sample negative spike in U (downward ~17 MAD) at index 580–584, accompanied by smaller but coherent N and E spikes; no clear opposing return within the window, though U begins recovering after 584. The event is isolated and abrupt, distinct from surrounding noise.

Sustained linear trend in all three axes from ~725 onward: N drops ~0.6 MAD, E rises ~0.5 MAD, U rises ~2.0 MAD over 5 samples; appears as a possible platform or step onset with ambiguous boundary—no prior offset visible, but the slope is unusually smooth and coordinated across axes compared to earlier variability.
